measurement.harness: Captured inline in harnessSource. The import path records the original workspace.

conditions.cache: fresh context and disabled HTTP cache
conditions.activation: CDP native mouse press/release with an explicit timestamp; input-to-ready includes dispatch and input queue delay
conditions.control: hover-control sets JavaScript navigator.connection.saveData=true. No server flag or HTTP Save-Data header changes. Other requests use real hosting and data.
conditions.notes: Readiness is timestamped inside the browser on the second animation frame after the destination condition first matches. The detector starts at trusted pointerdown; test-runner polling does not affect this timestamp. Laboratory measurements on the deployed site, not field percentiles.

limitations: These are controlled laboratory samples on production, not field Core Web Vitals or physical mobile device results.
The comparison isolates hover preparation on the same released build. The control changes only JavaScript navigator.connection.saveData, without a server flag or HTTP Save-Data header.
Each headline scenario uses a one-second hover before the click, a fresh browser context and disabled client HTTP cache. CDN caches can be warm.
Earlier pre-release About page-ready timings used test-runner selector polling. They are excluded because polling inflated the apparent delay; use the corrected same-build A/B results here.
